sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Player_Attributes"."player_fifa_api_id" AS e, AVG(("Player_Attributes"."gk_diving" - "Player_Attributes"."sliding_tackle")) AS m1 FROM "Player_Attributes" GROUP BY "Player_Attributes"."player_fifa_api_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m1" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
